newsitem.title: JAPAN: Eiken bid-only after rating change.
newsitem.headline: Eiken bid-only after rating change.

text.p: Eiken Chemical Co Ltd shares were bid-only in Monday afternoon trade after a foreign brokerage altered its rating for the company, brokers said.
As of 0422 GMT, the maker of clinical reagents was bid-only at 703 yen, after closing at 633 yen on Friday.
Salomon Brothers Asia said Monday that it had raised Eiken's rating from "underperform" to "outperform".
"Liquidity of the shares was not very large to begin with and it is gathering investor interest due to the ratings change," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
